title: Fiendish Resilience: Fire
html:
Fiendish Resilience: Fire is a variant of Fiendish Resilience, unique to The Fiend warlock subclass that lets the warlock become resistant to fire damage.

Description

Grant yourself Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.

You can only have 1 type of Resistance at a time.

Properties

Details
 Range: Self
 Recharge: Short rest

Technical details

UID
Target_Fiendish_Resilience_Fire

Condition: Fiendish Resilience: Fire

 Fiendish Resilience: Fire

Duration: Permanent

  • You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 10: The Fiend

This spell is a variation of:
Fiendish Resilience

Notes

  • This action technically has a range of 1.5 m (5 ft), but it can only target the user.
  • The chosen resistance persists through long and short rests. Recasting this ability is not necessary except to change the resistance type.
